description: Live service status (current train information) for a Japanese railway line: normal operation, delays, or suspension, with the operator's own status text in Japanese and English and when it was last updated. Live status is published for Tokyo Metro and Toei only (verified live 2026-11-13); for any other operator (JR East, Tokyu, Keio, Odakyu, Keikyu, Seibu, Tobu...) the response says status is not covered, with a named reason, instead of an empty list. Needs an ODPT developer consumer key via _apiKey; Pipeworx supplies one if omitted. Example: odpt_service_status({ operator: "Toei" }).

_apiKey.description: Optional: your own ODPT developer consumer key. Pipeworx supplies one if omitted.

operator.description: Operator with live status: "Tokyo Metro" or "Toei", or an exact odpt.Operator id (other operators return a not-covered message). Required if railway is not an exact id.

railway.description: Railway/line name (e.g. "Yamanote", "Marunouchi") or an exact odpt.Railway id. Optional if operator is given — returns all of that operator's lines.

name: odpt_service_status
title: Odpt Service Status
